categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the electronic information industry, focusing on research, development, manufacturing, and sales of electronic information equipment. Its main product lines include command and control information processing equipment and systems, software radar information processing equipment and systems, intelligent unmanned devices and systems, other information processing products, and specialized vehicle modification services. These products serve sectors such as command control, communication, defense, surveying, meteorology, and emergency response.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes autonomous innovation with core technologies in dedicated cloud computing, high-performance integrated platform design, intelligent wireless self-organizing network technology, chip technology, and intelligent unmanned systems. It has developed proprietary intelligent wireless radio baseband processing chips and software-defined radio technologies. Production methods include a sales-driven manufacturing approach with outsourced SMT and welding processes, strict quality control, and a full-stack product chain from chips to modules, complete machines, and systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily research institutes, enterprises, and large state-owned enterprises in China, including major groups like China Electronics Technology Group, China North Industries Group, and China Shipbuilding Group. The company serves defense and specialized industries with products used in command control, communication support, chemical defense, surveying, meteorology, marine detection, emergency firefighting, and intelligent unmanned systems. It also explores civilian markets such as emergency management, energy, railways, mining, maritime transportation, and low-altitude economy sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company's operations and sales are concentrated within China, with major revenue generated from regions including North China, Central China, East China, South China, Southwest China, Northwest China, and Northeast China. There is no significant overseas revenue reported. The company has established subsidiaries and R&D centers in multiple Chinese cities such as Shenzhen, Xi'an, Changsha, Shanghai, Beijing, and Nanjing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, development, and manufacturing of electronic information equipment and systems. It has vertically integrated capabilities covering chips, modules, complete machines, and systems, enabling it to control core components and system integration. It also provides specialized vehicle modification services, indicating involvement in system-level integration and customization.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The strategic focus is on autonomous and controllable technology foundations with an emphasis on intelligentization across all scenarios. The company prioritizes R&D in intelligent unmanned equipment, intelligent wireless communication chips (baseband and RF chips), and broadband wireless self-organizing networks. It actively integrates AI, cloud computing, virtual reality, and intelligent decision-making technologies into products. The company invests heavily in R&D, with expenditures exceeding 113% of revenue, and pursues breakthroughs in AI-enabled defense and civilian applications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of products and systems, including command and control equipment, software radar systems, intelligent unmanned devices, and specialized vehicle modifications. Sales are mainly conducted via direct contracts, competitive bidding, and commissioned development projects. The company also receives government subsidies and other operating income, but product sales constitute the core revenue source.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading technology enterprise in the defense electronic information sector with strong R&D capabilities and a comprehensive product portfolio. It holds a significant market position in command control and software radar systems with recognized first-mover advantages. The company faces competition from other domestic defense electronics firms but leverages its vertically integrated chip-to-system capabilities and AI integration to maintain competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 235.38 million, a slight decrease of 0.39% year-over-year. It incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 268.17 million, a 31.94% decline compared to the previous year. Total assets stood at RMB 2.3 billion, down 10.43% from the prior year. The company maintains a high R&D investment ratio exceeding 113% of revenue, reflecting a growth strategy focused on innovation despite short-term profitability pressures.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its autonomous innovation and comprehensive technology stack from chips to systems, delivering highly reliable, secure, and customizable electronic information equipment tailored for harsh environments and specialized defense applications. Its products integrate advanced AI, intelligent wireless communication, and unmanned system technologies, providing customers with cutting-edge solutions that enhance command efficiency, situational awareness, and operational autonomy. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, quality management, and customer service underpin its differentiated value proposition.
